content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in this securitization Transfer and Servicing Agreement.

input.rationale: Searches for "most favored", "no less favorable", "more favorable", "favourable", "terms offered to any other" and "match" return no MFN-type provision; the only "pricing" hit (p0692) is an unrelated Treasury Rate/reference-dealer definition in the Exhibit A notes terms. This is a securitization Transfer and Servicing Agreement between the Issuer/Depositor and Cellco as Servicer and Marketing Agent, and it imposes no obligation on us to extend to Cellco terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Absence of any MFN burden on our side is the playbook's preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
